notes.title: Regular Spawn Fix Update
notes.notes:
Had an interesting bug reported in the Discord. The player had a pre Summer update save, downloaded the update, deleted their old save, and started a new game. A shop variable from the pre summer version somehow carried over to the new save they started and prevented the Regular from spawning. This is a fix for anyone who experienced that. No need to restart your save or anything. Should automatically get her shop to spawn after talking to her on the beach.

Let me know if there are any issues, and take care,

Todd

notes.title: Hot Fix for Summer Update!
notes.notes:
This is a patch to fix an issue with the new bed stars that mixed up monster IDs during ghost haunt cutscenes, making the wrong monster appear, breaking the game.

I also updated the credits to include the artist of the new title screen and Steam promo art.

Thank you guys and apologies for any inconvenience. This update won't fix any saves that were effected, but you can hop into our Discord to find me, and I'm happy to fix your save personally.

Take care,

Todd

notes.title: Summer Update Now Live & Patch Notes!
notes.notes:
The Summer update is now live!

06262024
fixes:
brazilian text missing tutorial text for shamrock
in-game menu not disappearing after pressing "return to title"
void music turning off after pocketing a blessing during intro
weird effects if you activate huey's minigame before turning in oyaji's photo
photo location for ghost mons always reading "rest"

changes:
bed stars! a star floats above your bed for each cutscene that will occur at night. this is to help people know if sleeping will change something so they don't waste their time sleeping. it's also a good indicator if you're stuck. the presence of stars means something will occur at night, the absence of stars means there is something that needs doing on the island presently

regular now triggers a cutscene the night she opens her shop showing the flash item. this is to remind players about her and give more utility to the bed stars

if you free huey, then beat oyaji's minigame, huey's minigame will be available immediately instead of having to sleep to progress

screen transitions!

cursed blessing days reduced to 7 from 24!!

when activating a mon's minigame or item quest, their photo appears in your inventory, half transparent with an exclamation mark next to it, to show you haven't collected it yet. this way players can see what mons they haven't helped and where they're located. once you actually get their photo, the exclamation goes away and the icon becomes opaque

new alternate track by FesliyanStudios added for the main outdoor areas. slide guitar blues fits the island's vibe very well

new title screen art by Discord member Shu Bi! You can check out their website [url=https://shrewbean.neocities.org/]here [/url]

raised settings menu screen position so it's more centered

----------------------------------------------------------------

Really excited for new and seasoned players to try this update. The bed stars that indicate if events will happen at night, and photos now acting as a pseudo quest log, feel like needed QoL features that will benefit everyone. 

Besides small bug fixes, this will be the last update for a while so I can focus on making new games. Thanks for your continued support, and please share 24K with your friends during the Summer Sale!

Todd

notes.title: Summer Sale Update
notes.notes:
Hey guys! Hope you're having a lovely Spring. Wanted to let you know I'm putting some ideas together for a small Summer update based on feedback and personal "wishlist" things.

-updated title screen with new art
-more BGM variety for the main areas
-cool screen transitions, something i always wish the game had
-bug fixes. anyone notice that when you pick up a blessing during the intro the BGM stops?
-a very light kind of hint or "compass" system (optional toggle) that helps point players toward objectives to make the game more accessible for modern/casual gamers. i'll also try to encourage people to seek help here or the discord when toggling this option because it's important to 24K's experience to have some skin in the game as a player whether it's paying attention to dialogue or seeking help from the community

I'm still interested in marketing 24K and supporting it. It's been so encouraging to hear from people in the Discord and X about their love for the game. Still have my hopes up that it will reach a wider audience and gain that "Overwhelmingly Positive" status on Steam. So please drop a review or share the game with a friend if you haven't!

Have a great week and expect an update for the Summer Sale!

Todd

notes.title: Winter "Reunion" Update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40971997/27785a1c7a4d3a2b6cc6e594079022e1eb156175.png[/img]

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year from us at Happy Shabby Games!

This update features a new late game side quest that is started by using the new "Reunion" Blessing which replaces the "Good Zuko" Blessing. I wanted existing players who have already completed the game to have something to look forward to this season. I hope you all enjoy this peek into Johnny Puzzles lore, and love interest, Annie.

This build also features some fixes and changes, notably a scaling option to help players who want to enjoy the game fullscreen but are maybe using an ultra wide resolution. This used to cause the game to stretch, but you can now maintain the game's original aspect ratio while in fullscreen if you choose.

Thank you everyone for your continued support, and enjoy!

12272023
fixes:
marked some specific things for garbage collection that might cause slowdown when collecting a ton of whispers. i hope this helps anyone having performance problems. if not, restarting the game should clear things up
some menu options not displaying correctly in menu after changing language
oven letting you cook any item

changes:
"reunion" blessing replaces "good zuko" blessing. it now activates a new late game side quest
frappe item added
beacon item added
added new scaling options for either stretching or maintaining the game's aspect ratio. useful for ultra wide res or getting rid of black borders for resolutions that aren't 16:9

notes.title: Review Milestone & OST Update!
notes.notes:
Good  morning!

We hit over 100 reviews today, 100% positive! Thank you all so much for your continued loving kindness! Reviews help the game's visibility immensely and I appreciate all of you who took the time to share your thoughts about 24K.

If you purchased the OST, you might have noticed an update this morning. I added the new version of Dreamy that plays during the in-game patch notes.

Thank you and have a great day!

Todd

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello! 

This is Todd, 24 Killers' sole developer. Ahead of the launch this Thursday (March 9th) I wanted to reach out to everyone who is planning on enjoying the game. I've been working hard with our small community of testers to make sure this is a smooth experience for everyone. I anticipate a stable, functional experience for the vast majority of players.

If you do happen to run into an issue or bug, I will be present Thursday through Sunday, all day, and paying attention to this community and our Discord to fix bugs that are reported. Please have patience with me during the launch, and consider sharing your issue so we can get it resolved and get you back into the world of 24K.

Your time is valuable and I appreciate you supporting 24 Killers. See you all on Thursday!
